limitations: Only eight bounded functions are compared; no whole-game equivalence.
SetParryWindow TArray allocation/copy and FWeakObjectPtr resolution are stubbed; calls and branch effects are verified, not UObject lifetime behavior.
Original code bytes come from the matching locally owned EXE and are not uploaded as a runnable image.
Guard timing, Avoid collision, combo graph traversal, assets and rendering are outside this differential test.
